A) Zip 3+ Stunt: surf & draw 1 Action.
B) Wipe out: 2 Dmg & 1 Cramp!.
Or Improvise...

events.title: Wobbly Loose Floorboards
events.prompt: Every second stone tile wobbles like a seesaw above a shallow puddle of sticky mud!
events.printFlavor: Every stone wobbles over bubbly mud!
choices: A) Grit 4+ Stunt to balance across cleanly.
B) Splat! Take 1 Dmg and your next room move costs 2 Actions.
events.printRulesHtml:
A) Grit 4+ Stunt to balance across.
B) Splat: 1 Dmg & next move costs 2 Actions.
Or Improvise...

events.title: Complimenting Magic Mirror
events.prompt: A gilded mirror beams happily: "My goodness, what splendid hair you have today!"
events.printFlavor: "My, what splendid hair you have today!"
choices: A) Pose proudly! Heal +2 HP and draw 1 Action card.
B) Polish the glass (Spark 3+): peek at 1 face-down Room card.
events.printRulesHtml:
A) Pose proudly: heal +2 HP & draw 1 Action.
B) Spark 3+ polish: peek 1 face-down Room.
Or Improvise...

events.title: Bubbling Soda-Potion Bench
events.prompt: Bottles of fizzy berry, lemon, and grape potions bubble beside a sticky handwritten recipe!
events.printFlavor: Berry, lemon & grape flasks fizz beside a note!
choices: A) Sip safely: heal +2 HP (no roll needed).
B) Mix two colors (Spark 4+): success = draw 1 Belt Consumable; fail = 1 Dmg + Dealer Twist.
events.printRulesHtml:
A) Safe sip: heal +2 HP.
B) Spark 4+ mix: draw 1 Belt item (fail: 1 Dmg + Twist).
Or Improvise...

events.title: Singing Locked Treasure Chest
events.prompt: A brass padlock on a bouncy wooden chest is humming an off-key opera ballad!
events.printFlavor: A bouncy padlock hums off-key opera!
choices: A) Zip or Brawn 4+ Stunt: pop it open for 1 Tier 1 Loot!
B) Hum along awkwardly and leave it alone (Dealer draws 1 Twist).
events.printRulesHtml:
A) Zip/Brawn 4+: open for 1 Tier 1 Loot!
B) Leave alone (Dealer draws 1 Twist).
Or Improvise...

events.title: Ticklish Gargoyle Statue
events.prompt: A stone gargoyle blocks the archway, grinning suspiciously while holding a tiny brass bell.
events.printFlavor: A plump stone gargoyle clutches a brass bell.
choices: A) Tickle its chin (Zip 3+): it giggles aside and drops 1 Action card!
B) Try sneaking past (Grit 4+): fail = rings loudly & Dealer draws 1 Twist.
events.printRulesHtml:
A) Zip 3+ chin tickle: giggles & drops 1 Action.
B) Grit 4+ sneak (fail: bell rings, Dealer Twist).
Or Improvise...

merchants.name: Barnaby the Bargain Goblin
merchants.greeting: A cheerful goblin in a patched vest rolls out a velvet blanket covered in mismatched spoons and shields!
merchants.printFlavor: Stays face-up on tile (1 Action to trade).
deals: Trade Gear: Discard 1 equipped or spare Gear to draw 2 Tier 1 Loot and keep 1.
Bundle Deal: Trade 2 Belt Consumables for 1 Tier 1 Loot.
merchants.improviseDeal: Or Improvise: Zip/Spark 4+ haggle for 1 free Action draw (once/Hero).
merchants.printRulesHtml: Trade: Swap 1 Gear → draw 2 Tier 1 Loot, keep 1; OR 2 Consumables → 1 Tier 1 Loot. (Zip/Spark 4+ haggle!)

merchants.name: Granny Fizz's Portable Potion Cart
merchants.greeting: A sweet badger-granny wheels up a kettle cart smelling of cinnamon and fizzy berries!
merchants.printFlavor: Stays face-up on tile (1 Action to trade).
deals: Brew Swap: Trade 1 spare Gear or Consumable for Strawberry Fizz Potion or Wakey-Wakey Smelling Salts.
Card Trade: Discard 2 Grit/Spark Action cards to heal +3 HP.
merchants.printRulesHtml: Swap: 1 Gear/Item → Fizz Potion OR Smelling Salts (Revive); OR discard 2 Grit/Spark → heal +3 HP!

stories.name: Clumsy Blacksmith Pip (Part I)
stories.scene: Young blacksmith Pip accidentally welded his tongs to an anvil and needs spare scrap metal!
stories.printFlavor: Pip welded his tongs to his anvil!
choices: A) Help Pip: Give 1 spare/equipped Weapon or Armor → tuck S-01B (Helped).
B) Pilfer His Lunchbox: Grab 1 Tier 1 Loot → tuck S-01B (Grumpy!).
Or Improvise...
stories.printRulesHtml:
A) Gift 1 Weapon/Armor (get free Tier 0) → Tuck S-01B in Story Stack!
B) Pilfer lunchbox: Tier 1 Loot + grumpy S-01B!

stories.name: Master Pip's Turbo Forge (Part II)
stories.scene: Pip's forge is roaring on Floor 2! He immediately spots your party.
choices: If Helped: reforge Weapon (+1 Strike) OR gift 1 free Tier 2–3 Weapon.
If Pilfered: fight 6 HP Clanky Helper Bot (2 Dmg) before looting!
stories.printRulesHtml:
Helped: Upgrade 1 Weapon +1 Dmg OR free Tier 2–3 Weapon!
Pilfered: Fight 6 HP Helper Bot (2 Dmg) first!

stories.name: Upside-Down Mapmaker Barnacle (Part I)
stories.scene: Explorer Barnacle tripped holding his giant map upside down and sprained an ankle!
stories.printFlavor: Barnacle tripped tangled in his map!
choices: A) Patch Him Up: Discard 1 Consumable OR 4+ Grit/Zip Stunt → tuck S-02B.
B) Laugh & Keep Moving: Take 1 Action draw, no Part II callback.
Or Improvise...
stories.printRulesHtml:
A) Spend 1 Consumable OR 4+ Grit/Zip Stunt → Tuck S-02B in Story Stack!
B) Laugh & walk on (+1 Action).

stories.name: Navigator Barnacle's Shortcut (Part II)
stories.scene: Barnacle greets you on Floor 2 with his map right-side up at last!
choices: Reward: peek at any 3 face-down Square Rooms AND draw 1 free Belt Relic/Consumable.
stories.printRulesHtml: Reward: Immediately peek at 3 face-down Square Rooms on this floor AND draw 1 free Belt Relic/Item!

stories.name: Sir Reginald the Posh Badger (Part I)
stories.scene: A dapper badger in a tiny top hat politely requests a small picnic contribution!
choices: A) Share Kindly: Give 1 Consumable OR discard 2 matching-Suit Action cards → tuck S-03B (Friend).
B) Rude Shoo: Snatch 1 Action card → tuck S-03B (Snubbed).
Or Improvise...
stories.printRulesHtml:
A) Share 1 Consumable OR 2 matching Suits → Tuck S-03B.
B) Rude shoo (+1 Action, snubbed S-03B).

stories.name: Sir Reginald's Fancy Trunk (Part II)
stories.scene: Sir Reginald pops open his brass-bound steamer trunk on Floor 2!
choices: If Shared: Draw 3 Loot (incl. Tier 2–3) and keep 2.
If Snubbed: lose 1 Belt item (or take 2 Dmg) unless calmed with 5+ Spark apology Stunt.
stories.printRulesHtml:
Shared: Draw 3 Loot (incl. Tier 2–3), keep 2!
Snubbed: Lose 1 Belt item (or 2 Dmg) unless 5+ Spark apology!

themes.name: The Wobbly Shifting Maze
themes.rule: Once per full round, at the end of a Dealer turn, the Dealer may swap any 2 unflipped Square Room tiles on the map!
themes.printRulesHtml: Once per full round (after a Dealer turn), the Dealer may swap any 2 unflipped Square Rooms on the layout!
themes.flavor: Didn't that hallway go left five minutes ago?

themes.name: Goblin Flea Market
themes.rule: All Trap / Surprise Rooms act as shady bargain stalls too — any Monster may be bribed out of fighting with 1 Gear/Consumable via a 3+ Zip/Spark Stunt!
themes.printRulesHtml: Trap Rooms double as bargain stalls! Any Monster can be bribed out of fighting with 1 Gear/Item + a 3+ Zip/Spark Stunt.

themes.name: The Haunted Attic Basement
themes.rule: All Spark (Purple) cards deal +1 Dmg (Heroes AND Monsters!), and the Sanctuary Shrine has a polite Ghost Bouncer guarding the cocoa.
themes.printRulesHtml: All Spark (Purple) cards deal +1 Dmg (for Heroes AND Monsters)! Cocoa Shrine has a polite Ghost Bouncer.
themes.flavor: Spooky cobwebs, surprisingly cozy throw pillows.
